bill.title: Censuring Representative Andrew Ogles and Removing Him from the House Committee on Homeland Security.

aiDescription.summary: This House resolution censures Representative Andrew Ogles and requires him to appear in the House well for a public reading of the censure. It also removes him from the House Committee on Homeland Security, applying only to Representative Ogles and his membership on that standing committee.

impact.summary: This resolution would censure Representative Andrew Ogles for publicly making Islamophobic and anti‑immigrant statements and require him to appear in the well of the U.S. House for a public reading of the censure by the Speaker. It removes him from the House Homeland Security Committee.
